milestones.name: D810 SDK readiness
milestones.completion_contract: Version 2 requirements, native Phase 0 harness, SDK acceptance workflow, and redacted evidence contract are ready.

milestones.name: Single D810 SDK Phase 0
milestones.completion_contract: One D810 passes inventory, 10 captures, persistence, and recovery tests or produces approved SDK failure evidence.

milestones.name: Dual D810 sequential Phase 0
milestones.completion_contract: Two D810 bodies pass identity, 10 pairs, 100 of 100 stability, fault tests, and an approved transport decision.

milestones.name: D810 offline planar stitching PoC
milestones.completion_contract: Approved D810 optical fixture meets geometry, color, seam, crop, memory, and timing criteria.

milestones.name: Integrated sequential MVP
milestones.completion_contract: One operation captures CAM-A then CAM-B, preserves, stitches, and reports with safe failure handling.

milestones.name: Acceptance and packaging
milestones.completion_contract: Acceptance, durability, redistribution, installer, and release gates are approved.

work_items.title: Rebaseline canonical requirements from D750 parallel WPD to D810 sequential SDK
work_items.verification: requirements, source index, plan, ADR, and test contracts consistently reference D810 exclusive sequential control

work_items.title: Verify Windows native Phase 0 toolchain
work_items.verification: MSVC x64 and CMake versions are recorded; .NET is not a Phase 0 dependency

work_items.title: Obtain and isolate the official D810 Camera Remote SDK
work_items.verification: requester accepts the displayed license and the SDK is stored only under ignored local tooling

work_items.title: Implement Phase 0 CLI transaction and evidence harness with fake transport
work_items.verification: CMake build and CTest cover success, partial failure, ambiguity, persistence, redaction, and no retry

work_items.title: Implement Nikon SDK D810 adapter and redacted inventory
work_items.verification: assigned D810 and SDK capabilities are listed as CAM-A without committed real identity

work_items.title: Persist stable local CAM-A identity
work_items.verification: disconnect and reconnect restore CAM-A using only local identity state

work_items.title: Prove 10 single D810 captures and atomic JPEG persistence
work_items.verification: 10 of 10 first attempts yield validated JPEG, size, SHA-256, and terminal state

work_items.title: Run one-camera disconnect, power-off, and restart recovery tests
work_items.verification: each fault closes FailedPartial, retains evidence, and a fresh transaction succeeds after recovery

work_items.title: Register second D810 as CAM-B and verify stable identity
work_items.verification: three connection-order changes and both port swaps preserve CAM-A/B

work_items.title: Prove 10 exclusive CAM-A to CAM-B transactions
work_items.verification: 10 of 10 pairs complete with no overlap, retry, mispair, loss, or ambiguous adoption

work_items.title: Run 100 of 100 paired stability test
work_items.verification: machine-readable report proves 100 paired first-attempt successes and timing distributions

work_items.title: Run two-camera fault matrix
work_items.verification: disconnect, power-off, restart-after-A, order, and port tests preserve evidence and recover on a new transaction

work_items.title: Approve SDK sequential transport decision
work_items.verification: GO-SDK-SEQUENTIAL, approved REVISE-WPD, or STOP is recorded in ADR

work_items.title: Approve D810 A0 optical and quality contract
work_items.verification: 150, 180, and 200 DPI feasibility, rig values, chart, and thresholds are approved

work_items.title: Create rights-cleared D810 A0 fixture and quality oracle
work_items.verification: fixture rights, expected geometry, and thresholds are versioned

work_items.title: Implement D810 rig calibration profile generator
work_items.verification: profile round-trip and calibration residual tests pass

work_items.title: Implement constrained D810 planar stitch pipeline
work_items.verification: approved fixture produces deterministic output within thresholds

work_items.title: Add stitch quality, memory, and timing metrics
work_items.verification: good fixture passes, damaged fixtures fail, and resource metrics are recorded

work_items.title: Provision .NET 10 and create application contracts
work_items.verification: solution builds and domain tests pass on target PC

work_items.title: Implement single C++ Camera Agent and Named Pipe IPC
work_items.verification: simulated and hardware lifecycle tests prove one active SDK session

work_items.title: Implement durable sequential capture coordinator
work_items.verification: partial failure, ambiguity, crash, and recovery tests pass without automatic retry

work_items.title: Implement WPF operator workflow
work_items.verification: operator walkthrough and accessible state/alert review pass

work_items.title: Integrate automatic stitch and restitch
work_items.verification: end-to-end fixture and hardware transaction tests pass

work_items.title: Run integrated MVP acceptance rehearsal
work_items.verification: evidence matrix covers every MVP requirement

work_items.title: Review Nikon SDK, OpenCV, and native redistribution
work_items.verification: approved dependency and redistribution inventory

work_items.title: Create installer and diagnostic bundle
work_items.verification: clean-PC install, smoke, uninstall, and log collection pass

work_items.title: Obtain MVP release decision
work_items.verification: product owner approves release candidate
